gap.one_line: A foreclosed E3: SBT detects that a lawful SCALE-SELECTION layer is missing above electroweak_theory -- a layer carrying the dynamical-scale-selection predicate (why m_H^2/M_cutoff^2 is tiny) that the EW lens declares non-definable. The two endpoints are the substrate (electroweak_theory) and the bare statement of the hole (the open_question node electroweak-hierarchy). NOTE: the E3 verdict is FORCED BY NODE-KIND (open_question target, no accepted_observables) independent of the numeric residual; the descent Xi is corroborating, not the discovery mechanism.

thesis: GIVEN the audited frozen casting of electroweak_theory as a broken-phase GSW closure whose Sigma_f explicitly DISCARDS the scale-selection coordinate, and the open_question node electroweak-hierarchy as the bare demand for that coordinate, the E3 foreclosure is SBT locating the SHAPE that any lawful closer must have: a layer L sitting ABOVE electroweak_theory carrying a single new predicate the EW lens cannot express -- a dynamical/selection rule that fixes m_H/v relative to the cutoff. This card specifies the STRUCTURE (lens, predicates, relation to endpoints, role-profile) of that hole. It does NOT and CANNOT name the physics that fills it; and it consistently demotes 'a lawful LAYER is missing' to 'the shape any lawful closer must have' (the second endpoint is a renamed open question, not an exhibited layer).
non_descending_object: The dynamical scale-selection functional sigma : (cutoff, EW couplings) -> m_H^2/M_cutoff^2. WHAT IT IS: a predicate that fixes the ratio of the scalar (Higgs) mass-squared to the cutoff/Planck scale as GENERATED content rather than a measured input. Concretely it is the 'scale-selection coordinate' that the E043 toy model had to ADD as a hidden last basis direction because it is present in NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f: electroweak_theory's Sigma_f lists the Higgs vev and m_H as MEASURED INPUTS (declared non-definable), and the open_question node electroweak-hierarchy has no accepted_observables at all -- it is only the demand for the predicate, not a layer that carries it. WHY IN NEITHER Sigma_f: Source card electroweak_theory.Sigma_f, verbatim role: 'NON-DEFINABLE in Sigma_f: WHY the Higgs vev and the Yukawa couplings take their values' and the Higgs vev/Yukawas are 'MEASURED inputs, flagged so no edge derives them'. The target is a TARGET-only open_question node (no accepted_observables to descend to). So the object that would close the gap -- a sigma whose readout IS m_H^2/M_cutoff^2 -- lives in neither algebra. NON-FACTORIZATION WITNESS (B.2): two source states a,b with IDENTICAL EW input-knob readouts (same W/Z masses, same Weinberg angle, same Higgs couplings => same image under pi_0, indistinguishable in Sigma_f) are DISTINGUISHED by sigma -- a tuned vs an untuned scalar mass relative to the cutoff (L0_difference = 1.0 while D0_difference = 0.0). pi_1 does not factor through pi_0: sigma is non-definable from below. HONEST CAVEAT (audit): this witness is largely a RESTATEMENT of the source card's own 'non-definable in Sigma_f' declaration -- the toy model inserts a hidden coordinate defined to lie outside the source span (D0 last column = 0; L0 carried entirely by the last basis vector), so 'the source cannot see it' is near-tautological, not independent evidence of a missing LAYER. The genuine content reduces to the source card already declaring m_H/vev non-definable in Sigma_f.
required_lens_predicates: P-scale-selection: a functional sigma whose readout is the ratio m_H^2/M_cutoff^2 (equivalently the smallness of m_H/M_Planck) as GENERATED, not input -- the single predicate the EW lens lacks.

P-cutoff-coupling: L's lens must RETAIN the dependence of the scalar mass on the UV cutoff/heavy-scale sector that electroweak_theory's lens DISCARDS (EW keeps only renormalized broken-phase correlators below the cutoff; L must keep the cross-scale sensitivity that makes the scalar mass quadratically cutoff-dependent).

P-radiative-stability: a stability/ledger predicate that controls the quadratic divergence of the scalar mass under refinement -- i.e. L's audit D must make the scalar-mass radiative correction a CONTROLLED (decaying-or-cancelling) defect, not the bounded-away-from-zero obstruction it is in electroweak_theory's D.

P-selection-or-measure: EITHER a mechanism predicate that DERIVES the small ratio (a symmetry/structural cancellation -> the SCALE direction of the hole) OR a measure/weight predicate over an ensemble of EW-scale values that selects the observed one (-> the SELECTION direction of the hole). L must carry at least one; the gap's shape does NOT tell us which (see structural_vs_content).

P-EW-shadow-recovery: L's lens must admit a legal DOWN-shadow back onto electroweak_theory's Sigma_f -- i.e. coarse-graining away P-scale-selection must reproduce the EW broken-phase observables exactly (the descent L -> electroweak_theory must be a clean E1, no over-read of the EW accepted_observables). This is what makes L a lawful PARENT and not an unrelated theory.

divergence.verdict: partial AS WRITTEN, DOWNGRADED by the firewall to CASTING-DEPENDENT / CONTESTED (audit: divergence_holds=true, divergence_is_casting_artifact=true). The required STRUCTURE matches the conventional candidates on the radiative-stability axis. The DIVERGENCE (the hole is two-horned -- mechanism OR measure -- and the naturalness program narrows it to one horn) is NOT a robust structural fact: it is contingent on treating M_Planck as a true cutoff. Under a Wilsonian-physical casting where the cutoff is a real heavy scale, the mechanism horn is privileged and the measure horn is a casting artifact -- so the divergence is a flagged, casting-dependent hypothesis, not a field-redirecting discovery.
divergence.conventional_candidate: SUSY, compositeness, or a naturalness mechanism stabilizing the Higgs scale.
divergence.explanation: The required STRUCTURE matches the conventional candidates on ONE axis and is strictly more permissive on another. MATCH: every conventional candidate is precisely an L that activates P6 (controls the quadratic scalar-mass defect) and P2 (turns the free scalar mass into a constrained/stabilized quantity) -- SUSY cancels the divergence by a superpartner symmetry (a P6 audit-cancellation + P2 constraint), compositeness replaces the elementary scalar so there is no fundamental quadratic sensitivity (a P5 repackaging removing the defect). Both are 'richer-parent-above-EW with a radiative-stability predicate', exactly the card's shape. DIVERGENCE / over-narrowing (CASTING-DEPENDENT): the conventional naturalness program assumes the hole's P-selection-or-measure slot is filled by a SYMMETRY/MECHANISM that DERIVES the small ratio (the 'scale' horn). But the atlas-internal evidence (below) shows the SAME structural hole is shared by edges whose only available resolution is a SELECTION/MEASURE over an ensemble (the 'selection' horn). The gap's structure does NOT prefer mechanism over measure -- so committing to 'a naturalness mechanism' is fitting to the conventional candidate, narrowing a two-horned hole to one horn. HONEST FIREWALL READING: the two-horned observation is genuine standard physics, not motivated invention, but it is NOT a discovery -- it restates an existing physics debate plus the source card's own self-disclaimer, AND it is casting-dependent (the card's two_readings_of_divergence concedes that under a Wilsonian-physical casting the measure horn becomes a casting artifact and the mechanism horn is privileged). The required shape is 'a parent L with a radiative-stability + scale-selection predicate', which SUSY/compositeness INSTANTIATE but do not EXHAUST; anthropic/landscape selection fills the same structural slot via P-selection-or-measure's measure horn. SBT specifies the slot, not which horn -- so the verdict is partial-and-casting-dependent, not a clean match and not a manufactured divergence.

This is the atlas-internal evidence that the missing layer's hard content includes a SELECTION/MEASURE predicate, not merely a richer mechanism: even GIVEN a richer parent (string theory), the hole that remains is exactly P-selection-or-measure's MEASURE horn. It warns against assuming the conventional MECHANISM (SUSY) exhausts the hole. (Firewall note: this evidence motivates the measure horn but does NOT make the divergence casting-robust -- the horn question stays casting-dependent.)

structural_vs_content.sbt_specifies: (a) the SHAPE any lawful closer must have: a layer L ABOVE electroweak_theory (electroweak_theory is L's scale-selection-forgetting shadow, recovered by a clean E1 down-shadow); (b) the single distinguishing predicate L must carry (P-scale-selection: m_H^2/M_cutoff^2 as generated content); (c) that L must control the quadratic scalar-mass defect in its audit D (P6) and turn the free scalar mass into a constraint (P2) packaged as a fixed point (P5); (d) that the hole has a two-horned P-selection-or-measure slot (mechanism XOR measure) and that the structure does not prefer a horn; (e) that the obstruction is a MISSING PREDICATE (stable-positive xi_rel ~ 0.99), NOT a route-mismatch/holonomy and NOT a forced rewrite term -- with the honest caveat that the E3 is node-kind-forced and the witness is partly built into the toy model.
structural_vs_content.remains_unknown_content: WHICH physics fills L: SBT names NO mechanism. It does not say SUSY vs compositeness vs anthropic/landscape; it does not predict m_H or v (these are MEASURED INPUTS and deriving them would be smuggling, trap 2); it does not say whether the resolution is a symmetry (scale horn) or a measure (selection horn). It does not even assert L EXISTS as accepted physics -- only that IF the gap is lawfully closed, the closer must have this shape. The actual new physics is exactly the run-only / imagination-only content SBT is barred from producing.

casting_conditionality: GIVEN the audited casting of electroweak_theory as the FROZEN broken-phase GSW closure whose Sigma_f explicitly flags the Higgs vev/m_H as measured inputs and declares the scale-selection predicate non-definable, the required shape is 'richer parent L above electroweak_theory carrying P-scale-selection + radiative-stability'. CASTING SENSITIVITY: the shape DEPENDS on this casting in a specific way. The frozen card's casting_alternatives offers a SYMMETRIC-PHASE (unbroken SU(2)xU(1)) casting; under that casting the EW vev is not yet an input (it is the order parameter to be generated), which would shift the hole from 'why is the GENERATED vev small' toward 'what generates and stabilizes the vev' -- a related but differently-located hole. The broken-phase casting (the faithful one for the accepted observables) is what makes the predicate cleanly NON-DEFINABLE and the gap a pure missing-Sigma_f-predicate E3. If a competent physicist insisted the scalar-mass cutoff-sensitivity is an ARTIFACT of the regularization scheme (a casting choice in D), the obstruction could be re-read as a route/scheme dependence (P3) rather than a missing predicate -- a DIFFERENT shape. We flag this as the divergence-vs-casting reading: the 'naturalness is a real physical hole' shape is conditional on treating the quadratic cutoff-sensitivity as physical content of D, not a scheme artifact. TWO READINGS OF DIVERGENCE: Reading 1 (physics): the partial-divergence from the conventional candidate is real -- the hole genuinely has a measure horn the naturalness-mechanism program ignores (E037/E021 evidence). Reading 2 (casting): if one adopts a Wilsonian-physical casting where the cutoff is a real heavy scale, the mechanism horn is privileged and the measure horn is a casting artifact of treating M_Planck as a true cutoff. SBT cannot adjudicate; both are reported, and per the firewall the divergence is held casting-dependent.
out_of_sample_test: STRUCTURAL prediction, not used to build the card: IF a layer L lawfully closes E043 by a symmetry/mechanism (the scale horn) that controls the scalar-mass quadratic defect, THEN that SAME mechanism's P6 audit-control must, when its lens is restricted to electroweak_theory's accepted_observables, leave the EW broken-phase observables (W/Z masses, Weinberg angle, Higgs couplings) UNCHANGED at the EW scale (the L -> electroweak_theory shadow is a clean E1, no over-read) WHILE predicting NEW non-EW correlators at the cutoff/heavy scale that lie OUTSIDE electroweak_theory's Sigma_f (new states/operators carrying sigma). Operational atlas-internal form: such an L would appear as a NEW node that sources a clean E1 descent to electroweak_theory AND a non-trivial (xi_rel-bounded-away-from-zero) blind-spot residual on the scale-selection coordinate that SHRINKS to zero in L. A candidate L that does NOT produce the EW observables as an exact shadow, or that requires re-tuning m_H by hand (re-introducing the input), FAILS this test and is not the missing layer. PHYSICS REALIZATION: SUSY/compositeness predict NEW heavy states (superpartners, compositeness resonances) at the cutoff/TeV scale carrying the stabilizing content, recovering the SM below -- consistent with the structural test. A measure/anthropic horn predicts NO new states (the test's new-correlator clause is vacuously met by an ensemble), distinguishing the two horns observationally. HONEST STRENGTH CAVEAT (audit): this prediction is genuine and falsifiable but NEAR-DEFINITIONAL -- it is close to a restatement of L's defining requirements (lawful parent = clean down-shadow + radiative-stability), so it is a LOW-STRENGTH out-of-sample test, NOT equivalent to lattice-QCD out-of-sample validation (which predicts an unfit NUMBER). It was NOT used to type the edge (typed by the descent/recognition/run search on the EW->hierarchy pair alone), so it is out-of-sample relative to the card's construction.

No claim about L's content is made, so no speculative tier is warranted on the structural specification itself.

audit.verdict: SURVIVES AS 'CASTING-DEPENDENT / CONTESTED', NOT as a field-redirecting discovery. The card is disciplined and honest where it matters most: NO content overclaim (it refuses to name SUSY/compositeness/anthropic as the answer, refuses to predict m_H or v, flags those as trap-2 smuggling, and does not assert L exists), evidence is faithful to the manifest and the scored artifact, the up/down asymmetry and the §9 traps are respected, and the divergence is reported with BOTH a physics and a casting reading rather than sold. Three things keep this from being strong. (1) The decisive E3 verdict is FORCED BY NODE-KIND (open_question target, no accepted_observables) independent of any Xi -- the scored artifact says so explicitly -- yet the card's confidence_rationale leans on xi_rel~0.99 + the B.2 witness as if the descent test DISCOVERED the missing layer; it did not. (2) The xi_rel~0.99 obstruction and the non-factorization witness are largely CONSTRUCTED: the toy model inserts a hidden 'scale-selection coordinate' defined to lie outside the source span, so 'the source cannot see it' is near-tautological and reduces to the source card's own 'non-definable in Sigma_f' flag. The 'missing layer' is essentially the open_question renamed. (3) The claimed divergence-from-convention is CASTING-DEPENDENT by the card's own admission (Wilsonian-physical casting privileges the mechanism horn and makes the measure horn a casting artifact), so divergence_is_casting_artifact=true and the 'partial divergence' must be downgraded to 'contested/casting-dependent.' The mechanism-vs-measure two-horn observation is genuine standard physics, not motivated invention, which is why the card is not dishonest -- but it is not a discovery either: it restates an existing physics debate plus the source card's existing self-disclaimer. Net: a careful, non-overreaching E3 characterization whose structural SHAPE claim (a hypothetical closer must be a radiative-stability + scale-selection parent casting EW as its shadow) is defensible, but whose headline 'SBT detects a missing lawful LAYER' and 'divergence from convention' must be demoted to casting-conditional and de-sensationalized. Adversarial survival 3/5: honest and well-fenced, but the load-bearing 'detection' is node-kind-forced and partly built into the toy model, and the divergence is a flagged casting-dependent hypothesis, not a robust result.
